title: Subsidies and Accreditation for Singapore International Schools Sited Outside Singapore
what_it_is: Subsidies and Accreditation for Singapore International Schools Sited Outside Singapore

sections.label: Singapore International School Hong Kong subsidy
sections.summary: The subsidy for Singaporean students at the Singapore International School in Hong Kong offsets part of school fees, with demand and resources considered.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The subsidy given to Singaporean students in the Singapore International School in Hong Kong is an absolute quantum.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: It is used for them to offset part of the school fees.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: The Singapore International School in Hong Kong was set up in the 1990s at a time when there were many Singaporean adults who were working in Hong Kong with a sizeable number of children who wanted to have a Singapore-style and Singapore curriculum type of education there.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: MOE then extended assistance to the community in Hong Kong so that this would ease the Singaporean students' integration into our education system when they return to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We look at the demand and while there are many Singaporeans working overseas in many large cities, we understand that not all are staying in the same place and some cities are large.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: A lot of the consideration is driven by the demand from the parents.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: And, of course, we also consider the resources needed, the resources in terms of educators as well as funding, that have to be made available to these international schools.
